chunks: “The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was the most cautious of people regarding urine, to the extent that when he intended to urinate, he would go to an elevated place of land or a place in which there was much soil, out of dislike that urine should splash onto him.”

key_terms.اَلتُّرَابُ اَلْكَثِيرُ: abundant soil that helps absorb urine and prevent splashback
key_terms.اَلْبَوْلِ: urine; the substance being carefully avoided in this context
key_terms.تَوَقِّيًا: careful avoidance and precaution against impurity or harm
key_terms.رَسُولُ: the Messenger, referring here to the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَكَانٍ مُرْتَفِعٍ: an elevated place chosen to reduce splashing
key_terms.يُنْضَحَ: to be splashed or sprayed onto someone

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم avoid urine splashing when relieving himself?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the careful practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in avoiding impurity from urine. It highlights both ritual purity and refined personal etiquette, presenting the Prophetic example as a model of care in matters of taharah.
